title: Learning from Mistakes via Cooperative Study Assistant for Large Language Models
findings: The proposed SALAM framework showed improved accuracy on the 'Religion' task category of the BBQ benchmark compared to a zero-shot baseline, suggesting it can better handle questions in religious contexts and potentially reduce social biases.
